## tfskel

Simplify Terraform operations and project structure

### Synopsis

tfskel simplifies Terraform operations so teams can focus on building infrastructure
not managing folder structures, drift, or plan reviews. It provides clean, consistent,
and scalable Terraform layouts with built-in best practices.

```
tfskel <command> <subcommand> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -c, --config string   config file (default is .tfskel.yaml in current directory)
      --dry-run         show what would happen without writing files
  -h, --help            help for tfskel
      --no-color        disable colored output (respects NO_COLOR and FORCE_COLOR env vars)
  -v, --verbose         enable verbose output
```
